description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ConfigDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests configuration data access methods such as setValue, getValue, and getAllValues, ensuring correct interaction with the database and configuration fixtures.

classes.name: ConfigDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ConfigDao data access object in the OrangeHRM system, focusing on configuration key-value operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating ConfigDao, setting up fixture paths, populating test data, and creating the application kernel.

methods.name: testSetValue
methods.description: Tests the setValue method of ConfigDao for adding new key-value pairs and updating existing ones.

methods.name: testGetValue
methods.description: Verifies that getValue retrieves correct values from the configuration, matching fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAllValues
methods.description: Ensures that getAllValues returns all configuration key-value pairs correctly.

methods.name: _isValueSet
methods.description: Utility method to check whether a specific key-value pair exists in the database via a Doctrine query.
